items.title: 4.8 Theoretical yield, actual yield aur percentage yield (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.8, printed pages 89-91.

blocks.title: Actual aur theoretical yield
blocks.text: Kimiyai reaction mein hasil hone wale product ki miqdar actual yield (asal paidawar) hai. Balanced muadle se nikali miqdar theoretical yield (nazriyati paidawar) hai: product ki zyada se zyada miqdar jo reactant ki di gai miqdar balanced muadle ke mutabiq de sakti hai.

Zyada tar reactions mein hasil product theoretical yield se kam hota hai, in wajuhat se: filtration, distillation ya separating funnel se alehdagi, dhona, sukhana aur crystallization jaise amal, agar theek na kiye jayein, actual yield ghatate hain; kuch reactants muqabil side reaction mein hissa le kar matloob product ki miqdar kam kar sakte hain; aur reaction reversible ho sakti hai, to ulti reaction product ghatati hai. Chemist ko reaction ki efficiency (karkardagi) se dilchaspi hoti hai, jo actual aur theoretical yields ka feesad ke taur par muqabla kar ke zahir hoti hai: percentage yield = actual yield / theoretical yield x 100. Percentage yield jitni zyada, efficiency utni zyada.

Aspirin, C9H8O4 (180.16 g/mol), salicylic acid, C7H6O3 (138.12 g/mol), ko acetic anhydride, C4H6O3 (print mein molar mass 163.93 g/mol), ke saath garam kar ke banti hai: C7H6O3 + C4H6O3 se C9H8O4 + CH3COOH, ek mole se ek mole. 3.00 g salicylic acid aur 6.00 g acetic anhydride ke saath: salicylic acid = 3.00 / 138.12 = 0.022 mol; acetic anhydride = 6.00 / 163.93 = 0.037 mol. Salicylic acid limiting reactant hai aur aspirin ki yield par qaboo rakhta hai. 0.022 mol salicylic acid 0.022 mol aspirin deta hai, theoretical yield 0.022 x 180.16 = 3.96 g. Print phir actual yield 2.85 g leti hai: percentage yield = 2.85 / 3.96 x 100 = 71.97 feesad. Sawal ki actual yield 3.15 g ke saath percentage yield 3.15 / 3.96 x 100 = 79.5 feesad hoti.

blocks.caption: Yield ek table mein

blocks.title: Print ki jaanch
blocks.text: Hal shuda masla kai ghaltiyon ke saath chhapa hai: '0.22 mol' aur '0.021 mol' jahan 0.022 murad hai, acetic anhydride ke liye 'Mass of Salicylic acid = 6.00 g', sawal ke 3.15 g ke muqable actual yield 2.85 g, aur acetic anhydride ke liye 163.93 g/mol (us ka formula mass taqreeban 102 hai). Oopar ke adaad print ke tareeqe par chalte hain.

blocks.prompt: 4.5 kg limestone (CaCO3 = CaO + CO2) bhoonne se CaO ki actual yield 2.5 kg milti hai. Percentage yield nikalein (CaCO3 100 g/mol, CaO 56 g/mol).
blocks.explanation: 4500 g / 100 g/mol = 45 mol CaCO3, jo zyada se zyada 45 mol CaO = 45 x 56 = 2520 g = 2.52 kg deta hai, theoretical yield. Percentage yield = 2.5 / 2.52 x 100 = 99 feesad.

items: Theoretical yield: balanced muadle se zyada se zyada product; actual yield: jo hasil ho; percentage yield = actual / theoretical x 100 efficiency napti hai.
Actual kam hoti hai alehdagi aur safai mein nuqsan, side reactions aur reversible reactions se; aspirin misal: 3.96 g theoretical, 2.85 g actual, taqreeban 72 feesad.
